description: Add a price to an existing Stripe product: `amount` in MAJOR units (19 or 19.00 is $19.00, never 1900), currency, optional recurring interval and intervalCount, optional nickname. Read back. LIVE key: confirm:true after showing the preview. Idempotent on its arguments. Needs Stripe connected (Settings > Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

confirm.description: true on a live key, after the user approves the preview

interval.description: recurring interval: day, week, month or year; omit for a one-time price

intervalCount.description: intervals between charges, e.g. 3 with month for quarterly

nickname.description: internal label for the price; not shown to customers

productId.description: product id, prod_..., from create_stripe_product or list_stripe_products

name: create_stripe_price
title: create stripe price
